required_stages.description: Allocate the (rows, cols) output of IN's dtype inside run().
One device pass: interior = 0.25*(up+down+left+right), boundary = centre copied; OUT fully written by the kernel.

forbidden_substitutions.message: roll/unfold would form the neighbour sum in PyTorch
slicing arithmetic on the input grid (reference-style interior update)
host-side copy of the input to obtain the boundary
host-side halo padding of the input

required_evidence.message: a boundary select between the average and the centre value
the 0.25 scaling of the four-neighbour sum

outputs.aliasing: none: fresh (rows, cols) tensor allocated inside run()

timing_boundary.notes: Output allocation is the only host work and is timed; no halo preprocessing, no cross-call cache.
